name: FortiWeb — Obfuscated Web Probing
description: Detects obfuscated/encoded web-attack payloads — SQL injection, path traversal, Log4Shell/JNDI, XSS and SSTI — in FortiWeb web traffic by lowercasing and concatenating the request URL, User-Agent and Referer, then matching double-encoded (%25xx) and hex-encoded signatures that commonly evade signature engines. Protects the internet-facing banking applications (businessonline/mobile/mename).
false_positives: Application paths that genuinely contain the substring (rare).
WAF rule documentation pages echoed back in request bodies — exclude
query:
FROM logs-tcp.generic-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 minutes AND data.type == "traffic" AND data.original_src IS NOT NULL AND data.http_url IS NOT NULL
| EVAL surf = TO_LOWER(CONCAT(COALESCE(data.http_url,"")," | ",COALESCE(data.http_agent,"")," | ",COALESCE(data.http_refer,"")))
| WHERE surf LIKE "*%2527*" OR surf LIKE "*%252522*" OR surf LIKE "*%2520or%2520*" OR surf LIKE "*%75%6e%69%6f%6e*" OR surf LIKE "*%73%65%6c%65%63%74*" OR surf LIKE "*%2f%2a*" OR surf LIKE "*%2e%2e%2f*" OR surf LIKE "*%252e%252e%252f*" OR surf LIKE "*..%c0%af*" OR surf LIKE "*..%2f*" OR surf LIKE "*${jndi:*" OR surf LIKE "*%24%7bjndi%3a*" OR surf LIKE "*<svg*onload*" OR surf LIKE "*%3csvg*onload*" OR surf LIKE "*javascript%3a*" OR surf LIKE "*<script*src*" OR surf LIKE "*<img*onerror*" OR surf LIKE "*${{*}}*" OR surf LIKE "*{{*system*}}*"
| KEEP @timestamp, data.original_src, data.http_method, data.http_url, data.http_agent, data.http_retcode, data.http_host
| LIMIT 200
